# EnTT — Single-Include Header

Download `entt.hpp` from the GitHub releases page and place it in this directory:
  https://github.com/skypjack/entt/releases

Choose the latest stable release and download the single-include zip (e.g., `entt-v3.x.x-single-include.zip`).
Extract so that this file exists:
  third_party/entt/entt.hpp
